## Tujuan
Audit read-only kesetaraan URL/fungsi/intent situs legacy terhadap v2 sebelum migrasi; bukan approval redirect, publikasi, merge, canonical, atau cutover. Menindaklanjuti Issue #60 dan PR #65 yang sudah merged pada main@4a48b0e29c558089ddeacdfd9fff602995a8bbc0.

## Bukti GSC (ekspor owner 15 Nov 2026)
- Property: https://www.kalkulatorharga.com/; grafik harian tersedia hanya 17 Okt–11 Nov 2026 (26 hari), walau filter tertulis 16 bulan.
- Agregat bagan 38 klik / 2.475 impresi. Tabel Pages memiliki 32 URL; jumlah impresi halaman berbeda dari bagan; jangan disatukan atau diklaim sebagai histori enam bulan.
- /kalkulator/tiktok 20 klik/317 impresi; /kalkulator/emas 7/1.529; / 4/165; /kalkulator/saham/average 2/68; /kalkulator/tiktok-shop 1/231; /kalkulator/shopee 1/154; /kalkulator/lazada 1/64; /bandingkan 0/87; /kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark 0/12.
- Export Queries tersedia, tetapi **tanpa pasangan page×query**, sehingga mapping intent aktual belum dapat diverifikasi. Jangan infer keyword per halaman tanpa data tersebut.

## Audit dan acceptance yang diperlukan
- [ ] Bandingkan legacy vs v2 untuk /kalkulator/tiktok: input/output, asumsi penghasilan, ER, endorsement, negara/metode data, contoh hasil, metadata dan intent. Pertahankan route; jangan klaim exact parity sebelum bukti.
- [ ] /kalkulator/emas: owner menerima **scope manual saja**. Inventaris perubahan fitur live/preset → manual; jelaskan keterbatasan dan verifikasi contoh hitung/metadata. Jangan buka ulang keputusan scope.
- [ ] /bandingkan, /kalkulator/tiktok-shop, /kalkulator/shopee, /kalkulator/lazada: bandingkan preset legacy, input manual v2, kategori/fee dan hasil contoh. Owner acceptance manual comparison != approval seluruh parity hukum/tarif.
- [ ] /kalkulator/saham/average: **HOLD**, v2 404; jangan 301 ke /kalkulator/rata-rata-beli-saham sebelum feature parity impas, fee/transaksi, intent dan evidence. PR #64 frozen, tidak dilanjutkan.
- [ ] /kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark: **HOLD**, v2 404; tidak ada data benchmark berlisensi/metodologi matching, jangan redirect generik/retire/fake 200.
- [ ] /kalkulator → /: proposal 301 tetap belum approved; validasi intent/destination/query.
- [ ] Semua 22 arsip menunggu approval editorial/hak/sumber/privasi per URL; enam nonclick reference tetap unresolved.
- [ ] Intake GSC 6 bulan Pages, Queries, page×query bila tersedia, scope/filter/date/timezone, Indexing/Sitemaps; GA4 organic landing pages; backlink/404 evidence. Tidak memasukkan PII ke repo.
- [ ] Setelah bukti lengkap, susun matriks path: KEEP / REVIEW / HOLD dengan example inputs/outputs, SEO mapping dan reviewer, lalu ajukan PR terpisah untuk perubahan nonaktif jika diotorisasi.

## Guardrails
**CUTOVER STRICT NO-GO.** Jangan mengubah production legacy, DNS, domain assignments, alias, canonical runtime, redirect aktif, sitemap/indexing/robots/SSO staging. Future www owner choice tetap planning-only. Tidak ada perubahan kode atau approval implisit dari issue ini.

## Audit prioritas SEO: `/kalkulator/tiktok` — source-level review (15 Nov 2026, NO-GO)

**Evidence:** live legacy page `https://www.kalkulatorharga.com/kalkulator/tiktok` (public crawl; content may vary by crawl time), v2 main after PR #65: `lib/creator-analytics/engines.ts`, `tools.ts`, `components/calculators/creator-form.tsx`, `creator-methodology.tsx`, `tests/creator-analytics.unit.ts`, `tests/creator-analytics.spec.ts`, `docs/BATCH_12_FORMULA_VERIFICATION.md`. GSC export 15 Nov: 20 clicks/317 impressions in its short available window, **not** a 6-month baseline. No page×query matrix.

### Parity matrix
| Area | Legacy observed | V2 source | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| URL/SEO | Exact legacy path `/kalkulator/tiktok`; page promises penghasilan, engagement, endorse and username lookup | Same path registered, v2 title 'Kalkulator TikTok Kreator'; staged canonical **apex** and x-robots-tag `noindex, nofollow` asserted in existing Playwright tests | **KEEP path, REVIEW content/metadata.** Future www canonical planning only; no active edits. |
| Username | Legacy has 'Cari akun' via public username, shared data entry | Four independent manual modules; **no username lookup/live account integration**; explicitly disclosed in FAQ | **FEATURE GAP (KNOWN, NOT AUTHORIZED)**. Do not claim full parity or silently drop search intent. Product owner needs a separate disposition, with GSC page×query. |
| Earnings | Legacy derives monthly views = average views/video × videos/month; platform estimate RPM, endorsement, affiliate GMV×commission, gift; displays per-1k earnings and monthly total | V2: assumed eligibleViews × hypothetical net RPM / 1000; plus separately-entered **net** sponsor, affiliate commission, gift. Not automatically per-month, not from GMV. `incomeBasis` labels other sources only. | **PARTIAL CONCEPT PARITY, DIFFERENT INPUT CONTRACT.** No exact fixture parity across old/new without transformation and scope note. Illustrative v2 test: 10k views × Rp100/1000 + Rp200 + Rp30 + Rp20 = Rp1.250; existing tests assert result. |
| ER | Legacy shows ER per follower **and** per view, per-video interactions, tier and quartiles | V2 manual I=likes+comments+saves+shares; select follower **or** content-views denominator; average views=total views/videos; no benchmark tiers. Zero denominator->undefined, >100% not capped. | **PARTIAL PARITY.** Existing v2 unit fixtures: 1,000 followers, 3,000 views, 135 actions => 13.50% per follower or 4.50% per views. Two denominators require separate runs. |
| Rate card | Legacy user-entered low/high market offer, sponsored slots, illustrative market range | V2 computes low/high quotes from production+labor+overhead, target sale-price margins, and separate usage rights; slots=pkg count. Not market benchmark | **DIFFERENT METHODOLOGY**, cannot claim price parity. Existing v2 fixture: B Rp350, rights Rp50, margin 20-30%, 2 packages => quote Rp488-Rp550 and hypothetical revenue Rp976-Rp1.100. |
| Comparison | Legacy benchmark/tier/third-party sample comparison with median/quartile and contextual assumptions | V2 manual A-vs-B difference, no tier norms or benchmark dataset | **NOT EQUIVALENT**; benchmark route remains separately HOLD/404; do not make synthetic benchmark statistics or redirect. |
| Controls/testability | Legacy shared input panel and username action | V2 native mode select resets other module's values; manual isolated forms, Zod BigInt/rational, 2 decimals, error focus and SR results; Playwright desktop/mobile fixtures for 4 modes exist | **IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE EXISTS**, not a fresh executed browser test or live parity approval. |

### Technical findings and next gates
1. Math for four v2 modules is internally consistent with documented independent test vectors and source code. Browser/unit checks are present in repo and CI #72 previously passed; **no new test run claimed**. No evidence old/new outputs match on equivalent input because old input contract/data is different.
2. Preserve exact legacy URL and intent. Do not 301, rename, or change live metadata. When future code PR is explicitly authorized, make visible scope differences clear **before** migration (manual-only, no username, no third-party benchmark, RPM hypothetical and not guaranteed, net affiliate vs GMV) and verify SSR title/meta/schema/FAQ vs actual capability.
3. Obtain GSC **page×query** for `/kalkulator/tiktok`, plus other SEO baseline, to quantify demand for username lookup/benchmark before feature-retirement decisions. Review whether any legacy-linked `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark` should remain HOLD.
4. Production legacy, domain/DNS/alias, current canonical/redirect, staging noindex/SSO, and indexing remain unchanged. Future www host remains planning-only. **Cutover STRICT NO-GO**. No approval to resume PR #64.

**Result: `/kalkulator/tiktok` = KEEP PATH / REVIEW FEATURE-AND-INTENT PARITY. Not release-ready.**

## Audit fungsi/SEO — Emas + Perbandingan Marketplace (15 November 2026, READ-ONLY)

**Ruang lingkup sumber:** `docs/audit/legacy55/source-pages.json`, `docs/audit/deferred57/legacy-contracts.json`, `docs/DEFERRED_FORMULA_VERIFICATION.md`, `lib/supplemental/gold.ts`, `comparison.ts`, `tools.ts`, `tests/deferred-gold.unit.ts`, `tests/deferred-comparison.unit.ts`. Dibaca dari `main` setelah squash PR #65. Ini review source dan oracle terdaftar, **bukan eksekusi ulang unit/browser tests** atau bukti kesetaraan menyeluruh.

### `/kalkulator/emas` — KEEP URL / REVIEW EXPERIENCE & SEO
- **GSC owner 15 Nov:** 7 klik / 1.529 tayangan pada export pendek (jangan klaim 6 bulan).
- **Legacy snapshot** HTTP 200, H1 'Kalkulator Harga Emas: Harga, Karat, Kode, dan Buyback', harga acuan bertanggal merek (Antam, Pegadaian, Hartadinata, spot), tabel harga per ukuran, karat/kode, spread/buyback, contoh penghitungan. Teks legacy menyertakan nominal historis, bukan live quote yang dijamin berlaku sekarang.
- **V2** `calculateGold`: gram emas murni = (gross - nonGold) × (karat/24 **atau** fineness/1000); nilai beli = gram murni × harga murni manual; modal = nilai beli + biaya beli; buyback = gram murni × (quote buyback langsung **atau** harga beli × (1-spread)) - biaya jual. Selisih cash = payoutCash - capitalCash. Mencatat tanggal quote/asOf/maxAge, sumber, konfirmasi biaya/quote; incomplete/stale => no ledger. Tidak ada harga, pajak, spread, atau tanggal pasar default.
- **Independent documented oracle / existing unit assertion**: gross12g nonGold2g 18K P1.000.000 spread10%, buyCosts20.000 sellCosts30.000 => net10g fine7,5g modal7.520.000 payout6.720.000 difference-800.000 minimum quote1.118.519. 18K = 750‰; 14K/24 = 583,333…‰ **tidak diubah diam-diam menjadi hallmark 585‰**. Ini hasil unit test yang direview, tidak dijalankan ulang.
- **Gap SEO/UX:** tabel harga/merek dan ukuran serta prefilled contoh legacy tidak hadir sebagai data otomatis v2. Saat itu owner sudah menerima scope **manual-only**; jangan membatalkan keputusan. Audit metadata/title/FAQ terhadap query brand, harga per gram, karat/kode, buyback sebelum cutover. Jangan memigrasikan nominal historis sebagai harga resmi terkini atau mengklaim full feature parity.

### `/bandingkan` — KEEP URL / REVIEW EXPERIENCE & SEO
- **GSC:** 0 klik / 87 tayangan; tidak membuktikan 0 nilai SEO.
- **Legacy snapshot:** HTTP 200, H1 'Shopee vs Tokopedia vs TikTok Shop vs Lazada', tabel contoh Fashion price100.000 HPP60.000, status toko, tarif admin, biaya proses, payout dan profit; tidak ada kontrol input pada snapshot SSR. Contoh/tarif legacy adalah historis dan tidak boleh dilabeli resmi terkini.
- **V2** `calculateManualScenario` membungkus core settlement: sales, ongkir, diskon, fee manual, pemotongan nominal dari bukti, HPP; `compareScenarios` mensyaratkan keempat kanal lengkap dan jumlah unit/HPP sama sebelum ranking. Tax unknown / missing fee evidence / unsupported => status UNKNOWN, bukan 0. Ranking berdasar profit **eksak** sebelum pembulatan.
- **Existing test oracle**: 100.000 - 9,25% admin (9.250) - biaya proses1.250 = payout89.500. Payout menjadi81.500 hanya jika biaya lainnya8.000 **diinput eksplisit**, bukan tarif yang diasumsikan. Four-platform ties retain true ties; rounded-cash tie does not override exact ranking.
- **Gap SEO/UX:** legacy siap-baca dengan preset per-platform, v2 membutuhkan fee/kuantitas/HPP/bukti manual. Owner sudah menerima scope perbandingan manual, **bukan** equivalence maupun approval tarif/hukum, republishing konten lama, atau cutover. Audit title/meta/FAQ dan contoh skenario; jangan masukkan preset historis.

### Follow-ups yang masih open
1. Bandingkan contoh UI aktual dari browser terproteksi v2 dengan legacy (sumber yang sama, tanggal tetap). Periksa tidak ada elemen yang menyiratkan harga/tarif otomatis.
2. Tambahkan SEO `page × query` GSC 6 bulan bila tersedia untuk memisahkan harga merek/live quote vs kalkulator manual dan search intent tabel perbandingan.
3. Verifikasi konten legal/editorial `/biaya-admin-marketplace` dan artikel fee terkait per URL; masih menunggu 22 approvals.
4. Audit kesetaraan route `/kalkulator/shopee`, `/kalkulator/lazada`, `/kalkulator/tiktok-shop` secara terpisah; bukan otomatis tercakup oleh `/bandingkan`.
5. Tidak ada keputusan mengaktifkan canonical www, redirect, production, domain/alias/DNS, sitemap/robots/indexing, atau membuka SSO staging.

**CUTOVER: STRICT NO-GO.** Temuan source-level dan rekomendasi KEEP URL / REVIEW parity tidak sama dengan persetujuan release.

## Audit lanjutan 15 November 2026 — Parity 3 kalkulator seller (read-only)

**Sumber:** snapshot legacy `docs/audit/cutover/legacy-network.json` (8 Nov 2026); v2 `lib/platform-settlement/engine.ts`, `lib/platform-settlement/tools.ts`, `docs/BATCH_20_FORMULA_VERIFICATION.md`, `tests/platform-settlement.unit.ts`, `tests/platform-settlement.spec.ts`. Review source/test yang sudah ada, **bukan eksekusi ulang CI, uji invoice nyata atau approval production**.

| URL | Pengalaman lama | V2 & disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `/kalkulator/shopee` | Legacy 200, www canonical, kategori/subkategori, tier Non-Star/Star/Star+/Mall dan preset biaya/program (Gratis Ongkir XTRA, Promo XTRA, dll). Deskripsi meta menyebut 28 baris tarif sedangkan cuplikan UI menyebut 106 baris terverifikasi; jumlah harus direkonsiliasi, bukan diasumsikan tarif valid kini. | **KEEP / REVIEW**. Seluruh fee, basis, minimum/cap, biaya pemrosesan/promosi/logistik diisi manual. Tidak otomatis memverifikasi tarif atau tanggal berlaku. GSC periode pendek: 1 klik/154 tayangan. |
| `/kalkulator/lazada` | Legacy 200, www canonical, pilihan Marketplace/LazMall, preset kategori/tarif, biaya proses, PPh 22, iklan dan biaya lain. | **KEEP / REVIEW**. V2 tidak memilih rate menurut kategori/tier atau menentukan kewajiban pajak otomatis; skenario pajak tersendiri yang tidak terpetakan harus HOLD. GSC: 1 klik/64 tayangan. |
| `/kalkulator/tiktok-shop` | Legacy 200, www canonical, Regular/Mall, kategori, komisi dinamis, promo, biaya proses dan ongkir. Deskripsi meta menyebut 14 baris tarif, cuplikan UI juga menyebut 106 baris; butuh rekonsiliasi. | **KEEP / REVIEW**. V2 input manual, bukan creator `/kalkulator/tiktok`. Jangan menyamakan tarif Shop Tokopedia dengan TikTok Shop tanpa bukti. GSC: 1 klik/231 tayangan. |

**Kontrak v2 menurut kode:** bruto = harga×kuantitas; neto = bruto−diskon seller; fee 0–12 baris persen/tetap dengan basis gross/net/custom, minimum/cap hanya per pesanan. Payout eksak = neto + kredit yang terkonfirmasi − jumlah fee − ongkir seller − biaya lain. Payout cash dibulatkan sekali half-away-from-zero; hasil setelah HPP = payoutCash−HPP×kuantitas, **bukan laba bersih akuntansi**. Unknown scope, fee basis, shipping mapping, cap/min atau konfirmasi tidak lengkap menghasilkan status tanpa nominal; invalid ditolak. Ini tidak memverifikasi bahwa input pengguna sesuai invoice marketplace.

**Test fixture dalam repository (bukan pengujian baru):** 100.000×2−diskon 10.000−fee 5% dari neto (9.500)−fixed 2.000−ongkir seller 3.000 = payout 175.500; HPP 60.000×2 => 55.500 setelah HPP. Tersedia unit+Playwright untuk tiga route dan Tokopedia; tidak membuktikan full legacy parity.

**Open gates:** per-URL search intent (memerlukan page×query GSC), status lama kategori/preset vs manual, review metadata/FAQ yang mengungkap perubahan kemampuan, tarif terbaru dan pajak sesuai Seller Center, potensi pengaruh perubahan pada user, invoice fixture independen, GA4 dan backlink; 22 arsip tetap pending.

**No mutation/activation:** production legacy, domain/DNS/alias, canonical runtime, redirect aktif, staging SSO/noindex/indexing tetap sama. Future www hanya planning. **Cutover STRICT NO-GO.**
